people.imagined: Spring, the grove at the foot of the oldest clump, before dawn. He has just set the censer burning and is standing over it with his hands held out to it like a man warming himself, looking up at the viewer who has come into the grove. He does not hurry.
people.subject: The moment: crouched slightly over a small burning censer at the foot of a bamboo clump before dawn, hands held out to its warmth, he looks up slowly. Face, most important: a broad, slow, calm face, wide cheekbones, a wide flat nose, small kind eyes almost hidden in sun-creases, a grey-streaked short beard, an earthy brown skin; dried grey mud streaks his cheek and the backs of his hands. Hair: black going grey at the sides, tied in a plain knot at the crown with a green bamboo-leaf cord. Body: broad, heavy-boned, a farmer's stoop, thick forearms. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre robe, pale straw-beige, a plain crossed collar, with sleeves rolled to the elbow; mud dried grey to the knee on the hem and on his bare shins; a wide straw hat hanging on his back; a green sash. Hands and objects: a squat round red-clay censer with a thin lid, burning with a small ember-orange glow and a thread of smoke, hung from his belt by a cord and held lightly in both hands; a plaited bamboo-root ring on the little finger of his right hand. Background: blurred pale green bamboo culms in blue pre-dawn mist, a faint bell-shaped tube hung on one culm. Light: a warm orange glow from the censer lighting his face from below, a cold blue dawn behind. Faint red Fire warmth and green Wood hint. Expression: patient, content, with a slight weariness.

people.imagined: On the flood terraces at sunrise, a gourd in her hand, she has just looked at the sky and is only now looking at the viewer. Her trousers are rolled to the thigh and she is standing in a flooded paddy with the water at her shins.
people.subject: The moment: standing ankle-deep in a flooded terrace at sunrise, she has been looking up at the sky and now turns to the viewer, gourd in hand. Face, most important: a lean, sun-dark, hawk-nosed face, deep-brown skin etched with weather lines, high cheekbones, sharp, patient, light-brown eyes squinting from long sky-watching, a thin straight mouth; her chin lifted. Her lips are chapped, her eyes have a faint blue-grey ring about the iris, and a dozen fine lines fan from each eye corner from a lifetime of squinting at clouds. Hair: black, with a broad streak of silver at the front, in a tight plain knot under a wide straw hat tipped back. Body: lean, wiry, long-limbed, standing with a fisher's wide balance. Clothing: a short sleeveless fisher's oilskin of pale brown oiled cloth over a bamboo-fibre jacket; trousers rolled to the thigh; bare calves and feet wet. Hands and objects: in her right hand a bottle-shaped gourd, its mouth up, with nine pale rings marked inside it; in her left a palm-leaf fan with a long handle. Background: blurred stepped terraces of silver water reflecting a pink sky. Past her, a high thin cloud streaks the sky like brushed silk, and a stone dyke separates two terraces, one reflecting pink and one still dark. Light: low golden sunrise from the upper left, reflections shimmering. Faint blue Water hint. Her wet calves and the gourd both catch a thin line of sunrise gold. Expression: attentive, stubborn, measuring.

people.imagined: Night in the lower rows. He is standing like a heron beside a seedbed he has warmed with hot kitchen bricks, looking down at three sprouts. He has heard someone come, and has not moved his weight from his one leg.
people.subject: The moment: standing like a heron with his weight on one leg beside a seedbed at night, he looks over his shoulder at the viewer. Face, most important: green-stained fingertips and palms plainly visible, bright leaf-green dye to the second knuckle on both hands, raised in front of his chest; a long, quiet, narrow face, a high forehead, a straight nose, mild dark eyes, a faint worry crease between the brows. Hair: black, in a neat knot tied with a green cord. Body: tall, thin, sloping shoulders, the right leg lifted a little, the foot resting on the left knee. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre robe, pale straw-beige and clean, with a crossed collar and a plain dark-green sash; a small curved seed knife on his belt; mud on the boots only to the ankle. Hands and objects: in his lowered hand a warm kitchen brick wrapped in cloth; at his feet a row of earth with three small bright green sprouts. Background: a blurred dark field and a lantern. A low bamboo fence and a row of stakes tagged with scraps of cloth mark the seedbeds, and a hut with a single lantern stands in the dark distance. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, blue night. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: humble, diffident, hopeful.

people.imagined: On the rat plain at dusk, a rat-skin cloak over his shoulders. He has just counted a run of burrows and written nothing down; a bamboo rat the size of a dog watches him from his feet. He is calculating what the sack is worth.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on a plain at dusk, beside a large bamboo rat, he looks up at the viewer with a sly squint. Face, most important: the tip of his nose is plainly missing, bitten off flat and scarred, a blunt, healed stub with two wide nostrils, the face homely round it: a wiry, narrow, ratty face, small eyes set close, sparse stubble, big ears, a slack mouth with crooked teeth. Hair: coarse black, in a stiff short tail. Body: wiry, hunched, quick. Clothing: a cloak sewn from well-matched grey-brown rat skins over an undyed bamboo-fibre tunic of fine cloth; leather bracers; a wide straw hat hung at his back; boots mud-caked to the knee. Hands and objects: in his left hand a hawk-meat sack of coarse hemp; his right rests on the head of a bamboo rat, fat and brown, the size of a dog, whiskers and large yellow front teeth showing. Background: a blurred dry plain with burrow mounds and thin bamboo. A tall post with a dried rat-skin nailed to it stands near him, and a plume of dust from a distant herd rises on the plain. Light: low orange dusk from the upper left. Faint green Wood and metallic grey hint. Expression: shifty, greedy, secretive.

people.imagined: The granary gate at Hoàng Vân Thành, autumn, the seed carts behind her. She has just said the right thing to the right person and is laughing lightly; a bowl of steaming rice is on a barrel beside her.
people.subject: The moment: at a granary gate, she laughs lightly and tilts her head toward the viewer as if sharing a secret. Face, most important: a warm, comely, oval face, smooth rosy cheeks and a dimple, a small neat nose, bright, quick dark eyes with the lashes lowered; a ready, rounded smile. A tiny beauty spot sits under her left eye, and the faint scent of rice seems to hang about her. Hair: glossy black, in an elaborate high knot with a blue silk band and a pair of silver pins. Body: slim, poised, with a politician's open posture. She stands with her weight on one hip and her shoulders turned a little towards the viewer, a posture that invites a confidence. Clothing: a fine blue travelling coat of padded cotton, a stand collar fastened with a silver toggle, tailored to her waist, over an undyed bamboo-fibre inner robe; a small straw hat tied at her back with a blue ribbon; boots clean at the toe. Hands and objects: in her right hand a steaming bowl of white rice; her left rests lightly on a sack of seed. Background: a blurred granary gate with grain sacks and a cart. Behind her, farm carts with high wooden wheels stand in a line, a heap of pale seed sacks tied with green bamboo-fibre cord, and the granary's tiled roof with a dark crowd of figures at its gate. Light: warm golden afternoon light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and red Fire hint. Expression: charming, bright and calculating.

people.imagined: He is in the lower rows at midday, holding court for a visitor, his chin lifted as he says his daughter's name. A brass ring of keys jingles at his belt.
people.subject: The moment: standing proudly in the rows, chin lifted high, as he says his daughter's name to a visitor. Face, most important: the chin raised so high that the underside shows, a proud, jutting, double chin above a round, red, good-natured face; plump cheeks, a short wide nose, a thin pointed moustache, small eager brown eyes; he is beaming. The hair of his moustache is waxed to two fine points, a small wart sits beside his nose, and his cheeks have the burst veins of a man who eats well. Hair: thin grey, scraped back under a clean straw hat. A faint ring is pressed into his thinning hair by the hat's band. Body: stout, with a rounded belly, shoulders back. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre robe, clean and well fitted, pale beige, a narrow green sash; a short cape of woven straw; mud to the knee but a freshly brushed hem above it. Hands and objects: a large brass ring bearing many keys hangs at his belt and glints; his right hand points a finger upward as if making a point; a seed knife in a sheath. Background: blurred green bamboo rows. Behind him the lower rows run away in neat lines, each clump of bamboo tagged with a strip of red cloth, a heap of cut culms ready for the cart, and a small hut with a locked door. Light: bright warm noon light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: proud, trusting and greedy.

people.imagined: At the sluice at dawn, a key in her hand, she is explaining a measure to someone and is just stumbling on a word. She presses her tongue against her teeth, frowns, and says it anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a sluice gate, she speaks, her lips parted a little and her tongue tip visible between her teeth on a sibilant, frowning with stubborn effort. Face, most important: a brass sluice key hangs on a cord at her neck and swings in front of her chest, large and bright; a long, serious scholar's face, a straight narrow nose, ink-black brows, clear, steady dark eyes behind a slight frown; fair skin lightly tanned. Hair: black, in a tidy double loop tied with a green cord. Body: slender, straight, a teacher's posture. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre jacket, pale beige, with a crossed collar and sleeves tied back with cord; a long indigo apron skirt; wet at the hem, boots splashed to the knee; a wide straw hat hanging at her back. Hands and objects: a scroll-like measuring rod of pale bamboo marked with rings in her left hand; a sluice wheel behind her. Background: blurred stone sluice with water running out. A row of marked bamboo rods stands in the water by the sluice, and a small wooden board with a scale of notches is nailed to the post. Light: cool clear dawn light from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Expression: diligent, honest and determined.

people.imagined: Walking the fence at night, he has stopped, hand extended, because he has heard something under the brook. His eyes, wide open even in the lantern light, are fixed on a tunnel mouth.
people.subject: The moment: at night, standing beside a fence with a lantern, he stares with huge round unblinking eyes at the viewer or just past them. Face, most important: very wide-open eyes, whites visible around the iris, never blinking, a sleepless, haunted stare; a lean, long, sallow face, sunken cheeks, black stubble, a hooked nose, bluish shadows under the eyes. Thin dark brows arch high above his wide eyes, so that he seems permanently startled; a single bead of sweat runs down his temple despite the cold. Hair: black and greasy, in a short loose knot. Body: tall, stooped, thin. His shoulders are drawn up toward his ears and his head sits slightly forward, the stance of a man who listens more than he speaks. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre tunic, plain and clean, over which he wears a dark oiled cloak; a straw hat hanging at his back; mud to the knee. Hands and objects: across the back of the left hand, which holds a lantern up, a pale jagged rat-bite scar, plainly visible; his right hand holds a short wooden spike. Background: The fence runs away behind him as a line of sharpened bamboo stakes lashed with cord, with a dark patch of broken earth where a tunnel mouth opens beneath the brook bank. Light: a yellow lantern light from the upper left, blue-black night. Faint green and grey hint. The lantern casts hard shadows upward on his face and makes his eyes look like two white discs. Expression: sleepless, wary, shut.

people.imagined: On the tribute road, asleep on the cart with the ox picking the way. He has woken to count the carts and lost the count at four, humming. He grins at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated sprawled on a seed cart, humming, he counts on his fingers and grins at the viewer, having lost count at four. Face, most important: a wide, open, sunburnt face with big rosy cheeks, a snub nose, a loose goofy grin with a gap between the front teeth, eyes crinkled and a little glazed; a forehead lined with effort. A dribble of sleepy drool has dried at the corner of his mouth and his cheeks bear the weave-marks of a sack he has slept on. Hair: brown, shaggy, with a bamboo leaf stuck in it, under a crooked straw hat. Body: big, loose, comfortable. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre jacket, rumpled, a plain sash; wide trousers, straw sandals; a seed knife at his hip. The plain jacket has a loose button, a bamboo-leaf wrapper of rice cake sticks out of the breast, and straw sticks to his sleeves; his straw sandals are worn through at the toe. Hands and objects: his left hand held up with four fingers counted down, the thumb tucked; the right holds the ox's slack rope; beside him sacks of pale seed. Background: a blurred ox and road with bamboo. A broad brown ox plods ahead with its head low, the cart's wooden wheels, sacks of seed piled like pillows, and a long yellow road lined with bamboo stretches into the distance under a wide sky. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. The afternoon sun gilds the dust raised by the wheels. Expression: gregarious, lazy and happy.

people.imagined: Walking behind her master with his satchel of knives clinking, she has stopped to hold up her fingertips to the light and see whether the soot has spread. She hopes it has.
people.subject: The moment: pausing mid-step on a path, she raises her right hand to her face and inspects the fingertips, hopeful and anxious. Face, most important: the fingertips of both hands are black with soot, clearly dark against pale skin, as if dipped in ink; a narrow, earnest, pale face, a straight nose, level brows, steady dark eyes, a firm mouth. A pinch of worry shows between her brows, her eyelashes are long and straight, and there is a faint soot smudge on her chin where she touched her face. Hair: black, in a single braid pinned up and tied with a green cord. A stray lock hangs against her cheek where the braid has slipped. Body: slim, upright, a little stiff with duty. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre jacket and long skirt, clean, with a green sash; a canvas satchel at her left hip, bulging with the handles of harvest knives; mud on her boots to the ankle. Hands and objects: the satchel's strap in her left hand; the knife handles visible, wood and bone. Background: Behind her a path of packed earth between two clumps of tall green bamboo whose culms rise out of the frame, with a stone marker half in shadow. Light: warm morning light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and a small spark of red Fire at the fingertips. Dappled green-gold light falls through the leaves on to the satchel, which glints at its buckle. Expression: loyal, diligent and anxious.

people.imagined: On the terraces at evening, back at the sluices after being sent down. She stops and looks at the horizon where there is no sea, as she often does, and is only slightly sad about it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a terrace at evening, she squints past the viewer at the horizon, one hand shading her eyes. Face, most important: a squint of long habit, eyes narrowed to slits and a line between the brows, as if reading the open sea; a round, brown, sun-freckled face, a wide mouth, strong cheeks; heels visible: salt-cracked white heels on bare feet, pale fissures. Her cheeks and nose are peeling from the sun, her lips are slightly parted, and a few fine strands of hair stick to a salty forehead. Hair: black, in a thick braid with a salt-bleached tip. Strands of black hair are bleached rust-brown by the sun. Body: sturdy, short, strong calves. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre short jacket and trousers rolled to the knee, clean, the hem splashed with water; a blue cord belt. Hands and objects: a bamboo sluice pole over her shoulder; her bare feet in shallow water. Background: blurred terraces glimmering at dusk. Water-filled terraces step down behind her in curving bands of mirror, a bamboo sluice gate half open, and beyond them the empty line of the horizon, where there is only haze and no sea. Light: low orange evening light from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. The light is orange and low, and it turns the water into a sheet of copper. Expression: content, honest, a little homesick.

people.imagined: At the end of a furrow with the ox beside him, leaning on the plough handle to take weight off his bad leg. A clod of mud has dried in his ear and he has not noticed.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a plough handle at the end of a furrow, he looks at the viewer with a slow, humble smile. Face, most important: a lump of grey dried mud plainly caked in his left ear; a broad, brown, weather-beaten, lined face, a wide flat nose, small kind eyes, a grey stubble, missing a side tooth. His mouth is slightly open, a few teeth missing, and his eyes are a soft warm brown with yellowed whites. Hair: grey-black, close-cropped, in a coarse thatch under a wide straw hat, straw sticking out from the brim. Body: thickset, stooped, the right leg held a little off the ground with a limp. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp tunic and trousers of a servant, clean but old, with a rope belt; mud to the thighs. His trousers are reinforced at both knees with sacking and his bare feet are caked with black mud to the ankle; the hemp tunic has a sweat stain across the back and a rope belt with a wooden pipe tucked in. Hands and objects: both hands grip the wooden plough handle; behind him a brown ox. Background: Behind him fresh dark furrows run to the foot of a low hill; a few pale clumps of bamboo stand along the edge of the field, and a flock of small brown birds picks over the turned earth. Light: soft overcast light from the upper left. Faint ochre Earth hint. A pale diffuse light makes the mud shine. Expression: humble, patient and honest.

people.imagined: Resting at a clump of bamboo in the late afternoon beside a notched culm, with a milky eye turned toward it. He has just run his thumb over the notch and is quietly sure of something.
people.subject: The moment: crouching by a bamboo culm, he touches a notch cut in it with one thumb and turns his face toward the viewer. Face, most important: one eye plainly milky white and clouded, a blind blue-white pupil, while the other eye is dark and sharp; a deeply lined, old, brown face, a thin sparse white beard, a bent nose; the hand beside it shows a plough-handle callus as big as an egg at the base of the thumb. Hair: white and wispy, tied in a thin knot, under a wide straw hat with a tidy cord. Body: bent, wiry, old. He crouches on his heels with both knees up, one hand braced on the ground, an old man who still moves easily. Clothing: a plain undyed hemp tunic of a servant, clean and mended, a rope belt, trousers rolled to the calf; mud to the knee. Hands and objects: the huge callus on the right palm; a small knife in the left. Background: Around him an old clump of tall bamboo, its culms thick as a man's arm and the greenish-gold colour of old jade; on one culm at head height a neat square notch scored with a knife, and a second notch in the next. Light: The sun is low and its gold light shows every line and hair of his face and the milky eye glows pale, from the upper left. Faint ochre-gold Metal hint. Expression: content, humble, quietly certain.

people.imagined: Greeting a traveller at the edge of the lower rows. He pats his belly as he always does before a question, the ledger pencil behind his ear, and asks: does your bamboo seed every year?
people.subject: The moment: standing at the edge of a field, patting his round belly with one hand before asking a question, a cheerful look of curiosity. Face, most important: a long ledger pencil tucked behind his left ear, plainly visible; a round, friendly face, plump pink cheeks, a snub nose, bright curious eyes, a quick smile; a bit of stubble. He has a fine fuzz of beard on the chin, a small chipped front tooth, and a freckled nose. Hair: brown, short, a little sticking up. Body: soft, round-bellied. He stands with his feet apart, leaning back slightly, belly pushed forward in a friendly way. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre jacket and trousers, tidy, with a leather belt; a wide straw hat at his back; mud to the knee. A small leather purse and a ring with two keys hang from his belt; the jacket is clean but tight across the stomach, and the straw hat has a green ribbon tied in a bow. Hands and objects: his right palm on his belly, a small notebook of cut bamboo slats in the left. Background: blurred green rows of bamboo shoots. Behind him pale-green bamboo shoots stand in long straight rows with a wooden marker at the head of each row, a wheelbarrow, and a road leading to the distant farm buildings. Light: bright clear morning light from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Bright clear light makes the shoots almost luminous. Expression: pragmatic, gregarious, eager.

people.imagined: In a purple bamboo forest, mid-step, he has frozen to listen. A sound only he hears; his face turns slowly toward it, moss-green sleeves hanging.
people.subject: The moment: frozen mid-step in a forest of purple-black bamboo, head tilted, listening to something behind the viewer. Face, most important: sleeves stained deep moss-green from wrist to elbow, soft with damp and visible as he holds his arms away from his body; a gentle, narrow, pale face, a long straight nose, large dark eyes wide and distant, lips just parted. A thin pale scar runs through his left eyebrow, and a drop of dew hangs from his lashes; the lips are dry and parted. Hair: dark brown, loose, falling on the shoulders, a dry bamboo leaf caught in it. Body: tall, thin, one foot lifted. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre robe, with the lower sleeves moss-green; a plain sash; a small hoe slung on his back. A bundle of green weeding hooks hangs at his belt, and his trousers are tucked into soft boots that are wet to the ankle with dew; a satchel of seed cakes lies across one shoulder. Hands and objects: one hand cupped behind his ear. Background: blurred tall purple-black bamboo culms with green light between. Tall purple-black bamboo stands on every side, their culms glossy like lacquer, a green gloom beneath them, a narrow path covered with fallen leaves, and a hint of a hidden clearing. Light: dim green-violet light from the upper left. Faint green Wood and blue Water hint. Violet-green light drips between the leaves in thin shafts and gleams on the mossy sleeves. Expression: loyal, reclusive, intent.

people.imagined: At the harvest rows, shoving a slower hand off her row. She does not look at the girl; she looks forward, pulling a seed head, her ponytail so tight it lifts her brows.
people.subject: The moment: working a row at speed, she looks sharply sideways at the viewer as if they were in her way. Face, most important: a ponytail pulled so tight that it lifts her eyebrows high and stretches the corners of her eyes upward, a permanent look of surprise; two deep zither-string grooves cut across both index fingers raised at her chest; a narrow, sharp face, a thin pointed nose, hard bright eyes, a tight mouth. Her brows are thin and lifted by the tight tail, her cheeks have a harsh pink flush from the work, and a small scab sits on her chin. Hair: black, in a high ponytail. Body: wiry, forward-leaning. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre jacket with sleeves tied back, a green sash, a short skirt over trousers; mud to the knee. Her jacket's left sleeve has been re-sewn at the seam in white thread, and the green sash is tied in a double knot; over one shoulder is a small leather case of spare knives. Hands and objects: a curved seed knife in her right hand, a basket of seed heads on her hip. Background: Behind her the harvest rows run to the horizon, each with a worker bent to it, loaded baskets in the aisle, and a banner of plain green cloth on a pole. Light: Hard bright morning light throws sharp shadows from the tall culms across her face, from the upper left. Faint green Wood hint. Expression: impatient, brave and callous.

people.imagined: At the sluice in full sun, she is drawing a rope up. The sun has turned her brick red and the old rope scars at both wrists are white.
people.subject: The moment: hauling a sluice rope in bright sun, she looks calmly at the viewer. Face, most important: deeply sunburnt, brick-red skin on the face and neck, and thin white rope scars ringing both wrists, bright against the red; a broad, calm face, strong cheekbones, narrow dark eyes, a straight nose, a content small smile. Deep laugh lines sit at the corners of her eyes, her lower lip is cracked from the sun, and the peeling skin of her nose shows pale. Hair: black, in a plain bun under a straw hat. A few stray black hairs stick to her damp forehead. Body: stocky, strong-armed. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre jacket, sleeves rolled to the elbow, trousers rolled to the knee; a blue cord belt; a straw hat. The jacket is stained with water to the chest and the blue cord belt holds a small knife and a bundle of spare rope; her bare feet are planted wide on the wooden platform. Hands and objects: both hands gripping a sluice rope pale with water; a wooden sluice gate dripping behind her. Background: blurred terraced water and sun glare. Behind her a dripping wooden sluice with a heavy winch, a wide terrace of green rice, and a channel where the water pours down in a bright sheet; a pale heron stands on the dyke. Light: strong white sun from the upper left. Faint blue Water hint. Dazzling sun reflects off the water on to the underside of her chin and hat brim. Expression: calm, honest, content.

people.imagined: On the rat plain at dusk, setting a snare. She does not look up; her stare never leaves the trap. When she does look up at the viewer, it is flat and appraising.
people.subject: The moment: crouched over a snare on the plain, she looks up at the viewer with a flat, steady stare. Face, most important: pale, raised rat-bite scars in several rows up the whole length of her right forearm, held across her knee, plainly visible; a thin, sharp, narrow face, a small mouth with thin lips set in a hard line, cold unblinking grey eyes. Hair: black, in a tight short braid. Short stray hairs have escaped round her ears and brow. Body: small, wiry, crouched. She crouches on the balls of her feet with her elbows on her knees, absolutely still, the stance of a person who can wait all night. Clothing: an undyed bamboo-fibre jacket with sleeves rolled up above the elbows, clean; a leather apron; boots of rat-fur. Hands and objects: a loop of twisted cord, a wooden stake; a snare on the ground. Background: a blurred dusk plain and a line of stakes. Behind her a long line of fence posts, each topped by a dark small shape, stretches across a flat dry plain pocked with burrow mounds, and on the horizon a thin grey line of bamboo. Light: low cold orange light from the upper left. Faint green and grey hint. The dusk is a hard cold orange low along the horizon, outlining the snare cord and every pale scar. Expression: cold, paranoid, cruel.

people.imagined: 760, the wet grass below the purple bamboo, he has led forty unkindled disciples down and stands before a first clump of seed bamboo, hands held out toward it, asking for it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in wet grass before a young bamboo clump, he holds out both open hands to it, as if asking. Face, most important: a gentle, patient, lined face, a long peach-farmer's face, thin grey beard, thin white brows, soft brown eyes, a mild open mouth; his right palm shows a pale burn scar. Deep crow's-feet fan from his eyes and his lips are chapped, with a thin white scar across the back of his right hand from a hundred failed feathers. Hair: white, in a thin knot, under a plain straw hat. A few straggling white hairs blow across his forehead. Body: tall, thin, stooped, peasant-lean. His shoulders are rounded and his knees bent a little, as if still ready to kneel before a test. Clothing: a plain undyed bamboo-fibre robe, clean, with a straw cape. The robe is soft green-grey, cut long, and a plain cord of green rope ties it at the waist; his feet are bare in the wet grass. Hands and objects: a peach branch in his left hand. Background: Behind him forty small figures in plain robes wait in a loose group on the wet grass, a line of purple bamboo at the edge of the clearing and a low grey sky. Light: soft grey-green light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: patient, humble and devout.

people.imagined: The spring of 1050 among the flowering bamboo. She has walked out into it with her sleeves loose and stands among the pale blossoms with her eyes closed; the rat-bitten hands are held out to her.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a grove of flowering bamboo, eyes closed, arms lowered, calm. Face, most important: a calm, long, pale oval face with closed eyes and a faint smile, high forehead, a long thin nose, a firm chin, fine lines; pale yellow-green blossoms caught in her hair. Fine lines crease the corners of her closed eyes, and her pale lips are slightly parted as though breathing in the scent of the flowers; on her left hand are faint pale marks of old rat bites. Hair: grey-white, long and loose to the waist, with a bamboo flower behind the ear. Body: tall, thin, straight. Her shoulders are relaxed, and she stands as light as a reed, a little bent as if leaning toward the grove. Clothing: a long undyed bamboo-fibre robe with wide sleeves, pale and clean, a green sash. The robe's hem is spotted with yellow pollen, and a thin green cord of woven bamboo fibre is looped around her neck. Hands and objects: palms open, with pale petals dusted on them. Background: blurred pale yellow-green flowering bamboo. Around her tall bamboo clumps are covered in fine drooping blossoms of pale yellow-green, dust of pollen hangs in the light, and small brown rats creep unseen among the roots. Light: soft green-gold light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: calm, just and reclusive.
